web: Next.js dev, 127.0.0.1:3000 in Debug via adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000
protocol: OS photo picker via ADB; one warmup PNG, one warmup JPEG, remove attachment, alternate PNG then JPEG ten times each, then cancel one picker. Submit a single claim with the final JPEG.
statistics: median of 10 values per MIME and stage, excluding both warmups and the cancellation
limits: Picker includes UIAutomator and input latency. Upload includes token lookup and response parsing. ACK ends on web state acknowledgement. Local Debug measurements only.
